[s][size=3]只有聪明的人才能看见的皇帝的装扮[/size][/s][size=3]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]因为角色身上的衣服脱不干净会影响一些FS的服装和配饰效果,所以做了这个。
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]包含三个东西:透明头发，透明上衣，透明下装

用法跟其他FS模组物品相同（实际它们就是一组透明的fs物品）

2025.11.11 新增一个透明面具，可以用来覆盖掉眼睛，再也不怕使用眼睛美化原版的眼睛会露出来了。

2025.03.21 新增透明衣袖，透明身体
                   修改了透明面具的遮盖范围防止出现其他表情时露出来
                   增加两个假头，用于隐藏身体时使用，效果也等同于透明面具。两个假头分别是普通款和MEFB特有的头型。

关于透明身体:
本来它应该跟其他配件一样用FS实现，但因为FS的肤色渲染模式，当身体透明后，如果其他配件带有自定义肤色遮罩，会出现很奇怪的bug，所以我将它移到了CP中通过配置菜单开启。

现在你可以随意隐藏掉整个身体，我个人觉得应该会更方便mod作者绘制FS服装，因为这样就不用再考虑服装或鞋子是否在身体上合身，只需要在服装或者鞋子上将身体补全即可，完全可以脱离固有的体型自由发挥。

对于普通玩家，将身体隐藏起来后，不再需要考虑服饰是否跟自己所用的体型适配以及为什么自己的使用效果跟作者的不一样，只要衣服被补全了身体部分并换上了本模组准备的假头之一，就可以完美使用这些本来适配不同体型的衣服。 

你可以浏览本页的预览图，预览图中我没有使用任何其他体型模组，但身上的物品全部都是适配MEFB的，可以看见当我隐藏身体并使用了本模组中MEFB的假头部后，它们被完美的契合XD

[s]
The emperor's clothes only the wise can see.[/s]
Because the clothes on the character can't be removed cleanly, it will affect some of the clothing and accessory effects in FS, so I made this.

It contains three things: transparent hair, transparent top, transparent bottom

The usage is the same as other FS mod items (in fact, they are a set of transparent FS items).

[/size][size=3]2025.11.11, a new transparent mask has been added. It can be used to cover the eyes, so you no longer have to worry about the original eyes being revealed when using eye beautification features.

2025.03.21 Added transparent sleeves and transparent body
                   Adjusted the coverage of the transparent mask to prevent it from revealing other expressions
                   Added two dummy heads for use when hiding the body, with effects equivalent to the transparent mask. The two dummy heads are a                         standard version and a head shape unique to MEFB.

About the transparent body:
Originally, it was supposed to be implemented with FS like other accessories, but due to FS's skin tone rendering mode, when the body becomes transparent, if other accessories have custom skin tone masks, a very strange bug occurs. Therefore, I moved it to CP and enabled it via the configuration menu.

Now you can freely hide the entire body. Personally, I think this should make it more convenient for mod authors to draw FS clothing, as they no longer need to consider whether the clothing or shoes fit the body—just complete the body part on the clothing or shoes, allowing complete freedom from the original body shape.

For regular players, after hiding the body, there’s no longer a need to worry about whether the clothing matches the body shape they’re using or why their results differ from the author’s. As long as the clothing includes the body part and one of the dummy heads provided by this mod is used, these clothes originally designed for different body shapes can be perfectly utilized.

You can browse the preview images on this page. In the previews, I didn't use any other body mods, but all the equipped items are MEFB-compatible. As you can see, when I hide the body and use the MEFB dummy head from this mod, they fit together perfectly XD
